Requirements You are transformed into a plant by a polymorph spell.

Your plant form sprouts hundreds of spines, and your blood causes mild hallucinations in creatures exposed to it. Each time a creature touches you, hits you with an unarmed attack, or hits you with a melee weapon attack while adjacent to you, that creature takes @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage. Increase the damage to @Damage[2d6[piercing]] if the polymorph spell is 8th rank or higher, or to @Damage[3d6[piercing]] if it's 10th rank.

When an adjacent creature damages you with piercing or slashing damage, it must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class|options:inflicts:stupefied] against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure) until the end of its next turn.

These benefits last until you're no longer polymorphed into a plant.
